author: Zephyr I
title: LR schedule (warmup+cosine) on double-step+AttnPool (48/96, d=5, ratio=0.6)
abstract: Evaluate Adam warmup+cosine learning-rate schedule (peak LR ∈ {4e-4, 5e-4}) on the recommended double-step LN-ConvLSTM(48) + single-head AttnPool backbone.
